entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: The god of harvests, fertility and family on Theros, a nurturing figure with a scythe and sable who is especially revered in Setessa.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane on which Karametra is worshipped.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: City-state where Karametra is especially revered.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God of the sun, with whom Karametra has her most enduring bond.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God of nature who views Karametra as compromising the wild.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God of violence whom Karametra disdains.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God of war whom Karametra criticizes.

entities.name: Minotaurs
entities.description: People among whom Karametra's blood-based rites are preserved.

entities.name: Years of Rage
entities.description: A legendary year when Karametra laid waste to her temples and withheld the land's bounty.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: A period in which divine intervention ceased.

events.summary: In legend Karametra lays waste to her temples for a year and causes famine; humanity fasts and prays for seven days and she relents with a miraculous grape harvest.
events.quote: Moved by their sincerity, Karametra relented, blessing the world with a miraculous grape harvest that cured illness and ended the famine.

events.summary: Karametra is affected by the Silence of the Gods, when divine intervention ceased.
events.quote: Karametra was affected by the Silence of the Gods

relations.quote: Her most enduring bond is with Heliod
Karametra harbors deep disdain for Mogis

relations.note: A strained relationship over philosophical differences
relations.quote: Her relationship with Nylea is more strained.
